ios.desc:
Jam is the fastest way to capture dev-ready bug reports from mobile and send them to your issue tracker.

CAPTURE. SEND. DONE.

Turn recordings or screenshots of your app into a dev-ready bug report in seconds. Every ticket automatically includes technical details (OS, device, battery levels, etc.) so you don’t have to. This gives devs all the context they need to fix issues faster.

SEND TO YOUR ISSUE TRACKER

Send bugs straight from your phone to your issue tracker. Jam integrates with all your essential tools including Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Slack and more.

TRIM & ANNOTATE

Precise annotation tools let you show your team exactly what went wrong. This makes it easy to show devs exactly which button you mean, without any guesswork.

DEVS GET ALL DETAILS

Never again have a dev ask you what device and browser you’re using. Every bug automatically includes technical details such as OS, device, battery levels, and disk space. Now you can give the full picture, without any additional work.

LOVED BY TEAMS THAT SHIP FAST

Jam is trusted by 32 of the Fortune 100, and 200K happy users. Whether you’re at a startup or enterprise, Jam simplifies bug reporting so your team can focus on building great software.

“Quality comes from the speed at which we can iterate and fix things. Jam helps us move fast.” Diego Zaks (VP of Design at Ramp)

GET STARTED TODAY

show_hn.title: Show HN: screen recorder made for bug reporting on mobile

quotes.text:
Hey HN, when I was a PM at Cloudflare 7 years ago, whenever we’d test our site on mobile, it was super annoying to make Jira tickets: I’d take a bunch of screenshots on my phone, email them to myself, then go one by one and make Jira tickets for them.

Now 7 years later and this is actually still the way people do mobile QA. It takes ages to create 1 ticket let alone 10. How is there no tool for this yet!

We just pushed an app to the App Store that lets you record your screen and make a Jira/Linear/etc ticket right from your phone, and the ticket auto-includes device/OS level details like battery, memory, etc to help engineers repro.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jam-fix-bugs-faster/id6469037234

I would love to hear what you think, how we can develop it more to make reporting bugs from your phone practically instant. We’re looking at ways to capture console logs next. Curious what else you think would be good to add.

PS we are hiring - especially Android engineers to build this for Android too - so if you are interested, would love to hear from you: jam.dev/careers
